open_questions: Nose direction of each GLB was inferred from measured geometry (long axis X, narrower end at -X; ship_corvette_01 is the least certain). If any ship flies backwards, change its value in Ships.MODEL_YAW_DEG to 90.
Models 05 to 08 are not in data/ships.json, so they have no offset (05, 06, 08 have their long axis on Z and would need their own entry if added).
handoff: Models have the nose along -X (all four ships in data/ships.json: long axis X, narrow end at -X), while heading uses -Z. Offsets live in game/ships.gd as const MODEL_YAW_DEG (small, bulk, dart, fleet = -90 degrees), read via Ships.model_yaw(id) and Ships.model_yaw_for_path(path). Pathfinder view and rival ships wrap the model in a pivot node rotated by that offset; heading and motion code are unchanged. Not checked by eye. Tests pass: 2875, fail 0.
